mapper.sql: b.id,b.settlement_batch_no batchNo,b.factory_id factoryId,f.factory_name factoryName,IF(b.settlement_status='settled','settled','processing') status,b.order_count orderCount, CAST(b.rent_settle_base_amount_fen AS CHAR) rentBaseFen,CAST(b.platform_commission_amount_fen AS CHAR) commissionFen,CAST(b.deposit_compensation_amount_fen AS CHAR) depositCompensationFen, CAST(b.freight_reimbursement_amount_fen AS CHAR) freightFen,CAST(b.factory_settle_amount_fen AS CHAR) factorySettleFen,CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(w.actual_unlock_amount_fen) FROM wechat_profit_sharing_order w WHERE w.settlement_batch_id=b.id),0) AS CHAR) actualUnlockFen, CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(b.generated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') generatedAt,CONCAT(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(b.settled_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') settledAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM factory_settlement_batch b JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=b.factory_id ORDER BY b.generated_at DESC,b.id DESC LIMIT #{query.page.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.page.offset}
mapper.sql: FROM factory_settlement_batch b JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=b.factory_id WHERE b.id=#{id} AND b.factory_id=#{owner} AND b.settlement_status='settled'
mapper.select: SELECT p.receiver_name_snapshot receiver,p.receiver_account_masked_snapshot masked, (SELECT MAX(last_queried_at) FROM wechat_profit_sharing_order WHERE settlement_batch_id=#{id}) checked, (SELECT exception_code FROM wechat_profit_sharing_order WHERE settlement_batch_id=#{id} AND exception_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) exception, (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM admin_operation_audit WHERE target_type='factory_settlement_batch' AND target_id=#{id} AND operation_code='acknowledgeSettlement' AND admin_user_id=#{actor}) acknowledged FROM factory_settlement_payment p WHERE p.settlement_batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY p.payment_attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM factory_settlement_detail WHERE settlement_batch_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custom_order_settlement WHERE settlement_batch_id=#{id})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wechat_profit_sharing_order WHERE settlement_batch_id=#{id}

SELECT id,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(after_snapshot_json,'$.requestHash')) digest,created_at at FROM admin_operation_audit WHERE admin_user_id=#{actor} AND operation_code='acknowledgeSettlement' AND target_type='factory_settlement_batch' AND target_id=#{id} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
